purpose: Define persistence/recovery/security semantics across APW without creating a second state engine.
core_invariants: one user intent uses one stable operation identity across retries
accepted business effects occur at most once
authoritative mutations carry expected-version or equivalent owning-domain preconditions
stale state never silently overwrites newer state
ambiguous failure is resolved by status lookup before retry
live asynchronous and hybrid cadence share one Campaign identity and authoritative history
authorization/visibility filtering precedes counts search history notifications diagnostics exports and optional-assistance context
permission entitlement lifecycle pack and schema are revalidated on reconnect or protected restore
local drafts are never represented as accepted state

operation_families.authoritative_owner: existing Action/proposal and Campaign owning domains

operation_families.stable_id: decision operation ID bound to proposal ID

recovery_rules.condition: network drops after submit before response
recovery_rules.required: preserve same operation ID; show status-unknown; query authoritative status; never create new intent automatically

recovery_rules.condition: Event committed but realtime delivery missed
recovery_rules.required: recover from last acknowledged Event cursor or verified projection/checkpoint; apply authorized Events once
reauthorize before restore; reduce/deny projection; lock or purge protected cache per policy; no old label/count/preview leak
preserve committed history; re-evaluate future access/use; offline snapshot cannot extend entitlement indefinitely
preserve both drafts; compare against current version; no silent last-write-wins

recovery_rules.condition: live state changes while async proposal pending
recovery_rules.required: pending evidence remains; decision rechecks current version/authority; incompatible work becomes stale/review-required
durable commands/Events/status/checkpoints survive; clients recover from cursor/status; accepted history is not erased
reauthorize and version-check; reconcile/branch/conflict; offline copy never overwrites authoritative state

notification_rules.authority: notification is projection/discovery, never business-state authority
notification_rules.durability: underlying operation/outcome is durable; notification may be reconstructed
notification_rules.delivery_failure: cannot roll back or re-execute underlying operation
notification_rules.privacy: recipient-safe metadata only; no unauthorized payload or hidden cardinality

history_ordering.cadence_rule: live async and hybrid use one Campaign history rather than cadence-specific ledgers
